paper_title: First Results from the Taiwan Axion Search Experiment with Haloscope at 19.6 $μ$eV
coupling_convention: |g_agamma| in GeV^-1 (plot axis in units of 10^-14 GeV^-1, multiplier applied)
notes: First results from TASEH haloscope, frequency range 4.70750-4.79815 GHz (mass 19.4687-19.8436 ueV). 95% C.L. upper limits on |g_agamma| range from 5.3e-14 to 8.9e-14 GeV^-1 with average 8.2e-14 GeV^-1; the average value is used as a flat bound over the scanned mass range since the full frequency-dependent limit curve (Fig. 2) is not tabulated in the text. Assumes axions are 100% of local DM with rho = 0.45 GeV/cm^3, standard Maxwellian line shape (v^2 = (270 km/s)^2). Two frequency ranges (4.71017-4.71019 and 4.74730-4.74738 GHz) excluded from limits due to non-axion interference signals. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.85, 36)) | Vision: Main plot: 95% C.L. |g_agamma| limit vs frequency 4.7075-4.79815 GHz (mass 19.4687-19.8436 ueV), linear axes.
